group.passage: Every winter, huge numbers of purple crow butterflies rest in warm valleys in southern Taiwan. Text A is a report by a researcher who studies them. Text B is a news story about what happens on a busy highway when the butterflies travel north in spring.

passage_parts.label: A
passage_parts.title: Notes from Butterfly Valley
passage_parts.text: For many years, I have studied purple crow butterflies in Maolin, Kaohsiung. The name “purple crow” does not belong to just one kind of butterfly. It covers four kinds that look very much alike. From late fall, they fly south and spend the cold months in the quiet, warm valleys here, resting together in large groups. When the sun shines on their dark wings, the wings flash purple. To learn about their journey, my team catches some of the butterflies, marks a short code on their wings, and lets them go again. In spring, when the wind blows from the south and the weather is dry, the butterflies leave the valley and head north to lay eggs. If someone finds a butterfly with a code, they can tell us where and when they saw it. One butterfly we marked here was later found about 100 kilometers away. Each report helps us learn more about the way they travel.

passage_parts.label: B
passage_parts.title: Highway Lane Closes for Butterflies
passage_parts.text: Drivers on National Highway No. 3 in Linnei, Yunlin, found one lane closed yesterday morning. There had been no accident. The reason was butterflies. Every spring, purple crow butterflies leave their winter home in southern Taiwan and fly north, and part of their route crosses this highway. Years ago, thousands of them were hit by fast cars. Since 2007, the highway office has taken steps to protect them. Along the road, it has set up a net about 1,100 meters long and four meters high, which makes the butterflies fly higher, above the traffic. A local butterfly group counts the butterflies every morning. When more than 250 of them cross in one minute, the outer lane is closed. Drivers do not need to slow down. They only need to keep to the speed limit. The best time to see the butterflies is between nine and eleven in the morning.

questions.stem: In Text B, which noun means “the path that something follows when it travels from one place to another”?（簡答題，2分）

1.explanation_zh: Text A 的研究者說，為了了解蝴蝶的旅程，團隊會捉一些蝴蝶，marks a short code on their wings（在翅膀上標上簡短的編號），再把牠們放走。空格前是介系詞 by（藉由…），要用動名詞，所以 marks 改成 marking。before letting them go 說明這件事發生在放走蝴蝶之前，所以是研究團隊「標上」編號，不是別人後來「發現」編號。
evidence: To learn about their journey, my team catches some of the butterflies, marks a short code on their wings, and lets them go again.
1.strategy_zh: 用 journey、codes、wings 回到 Text A；by 後面的動詞用 V-ing。
hints: 空格前是介系詞 by：要填動名詞（V-ing）。
回到 Text A：研究團隊在蝴蝶翅膀上做了什麼，好追蹤牠們的旅程？
原文 my team … ___ a short code on their wings；把這個動詞改成 V-ing。

2.explanation_zh: Text B 說 When more than 250 of them cross in one minute, the outer lane is closed（一分鐘內超過 250 隻蝴蝶飛越時，外側車道就封閉）。空格前是 are，表示「正在」飛越道路的進行式，所以 cross 改成 crossing；cross the road 是「越過道路」。
evidence: When more than 250 of them cross in one minute, the outer lane is closed.
2.strategy_zh: 用 outer lane、closed 回到 Text B 找封道的條件；be 動詞後面表示「正在做」用 V-ing。
hints: 空格前是 are：要填現在分詞（V-ing），表示正在進行。
回到 Text B：蝴蝶在一分鐘內做了什麼，外側車道就會封閉？
原文 When more than 250 of them ___ in one minute；把這個動詞改成 V-ing。

3.explanation_zh: 兩篇都提到的是 A、D。A：Text A 說春天起南風、天氣乾燥時，蝴蝶離開山谷往北飛；Text B 說每年春天紫斑蝶離開南部的過冬地往北飛。D：Text A 的團隊替蝴蝶標上編號，也請發現蝴蝶的人回報時間地點；Text B 有在地的蝴蝶團體每天早上計算蝴蝶數量。B 的翅膀編號只在 Text A；E 的封閉車道只在 Text B；C 和 Text A「紫斑蝶包含四種」矛盾；F 和兩篇矛盾：牠們在茂林的山谷過冬，林內只是北返路線經過的地方。
evidence: In spring, when the wind blows from the south and the weather is dry, the butterflies leave the valley and head north to lay eggs.
Every spring, purple crow butterflies leave their winter home in southern Taiwan and fly north, and part of their route crosses this highway.
If someone finds a butterfly with a code, they can tell us where and when they saw it.
A local butterfly group counts the butterflies every morning.

option_notes_zh.B: 只有 Text A 提到在翅膀上標編號；Text B 的蝴蝶團體只是計算數量，沒有提到編號，只符合一方。
option_notes_zh.C: 和明文矛盾：Text A 說 purple crow 這個名字不只指一種蝴蝶，而是外觀很像的四種（four kinds）。
option_notes_zh.E: 只有 Text B 提到一分鐘超過 250 隻就封閉外側車道；Text A 沒有提到公路，只符合一方。
option_notes_zh.F: 和明文矛盾：Text A 說牠們在高雄茂林溫暖的山谷過冬；Text B 說牠們從南部的過冬地往北飛時，路線經過林內的國道。

3.strategy_zh: 「兩篇都提到」題：每個選項都要在兩篇各找到依據。D 要把 Text A 的「回報編號蝴蝶」和 Text B 的「計算數量」都看成「蒐集蝴蝶的資料」；B、E 各只出現在一篇。
hints: 題目問兩篇「都」提到的內容，只出現在一篇的不能選。
比較兩篇：蝴蝶什麼季節往哪裡飛？兩篇裡有誰在記錄或計算蝴蝶？
兩篇都有「春天往北飛」和「有人記錄、計算蝴蝶」；編號只在 Text A，封道只在 Text B。

evidence: Every spring, purple crow butterflies leave their winter home in southern Taiwan and fly north, and part of their route crosses this highway.

hints: 要找一個名詞，意思是「從一個地方到另一個地方所走的路徑」。
看 Text B：蝴蝶往北飛時，牠們的什麼跨越了這條國道？

translation_zh.text:
【引言】每年冬天，大量的紫斑蝶在台灣南部溫暖的山谷裡休息。Text A 是一位研究紫斑蝶的研究者寫的報告；Text B 是一則新聞，報導春天蝴蝶北返時，一條繁忙的國道上發生了什麼事。
【A 蝴蝶谷筆記】多年來，我一直在高雄茂林研究紫斑蝶。「紫斑蝶」這個名字不只指一種蝴蝶，而是包括外觀非常相像的四種。從深秋開始，牠們往南飛，在這裡安靜溫暖的山谷裡度過寒冷的幾個月，成群聚在一起休息。陽光照在牠們深色的翅膀上時，翅膀會閃出紫色的光。為了了解牠們的旅程，我的團隊會捉一些蝴蝶，在翅膀上標上簡短的編號，再把牠們放走。春天時，只要吹起南風、天氣乾燥，蝴蝶就會離開山谷，往北飛去產卵。如果有人發現帶著編號的蝴蝶，可以告訴我們在哪裡、什麼時候看到的。我們在這裡標記的一隻蝴蝶，後來在大約 100 公里外被發現。每一筆回報都幫助我們更了解牠們遷徙的方式。
【B 國道為蝴蝶封閉車道】昨天早上，行經雲林林內國道三號的駕駛人發現有一個車道封閉了。原因不是車禍，而是蝴蝶。每年春天，紫斑蝶離開台灣南部的過冬地往北飛，牠們的路線有一段跨越這條國道。多年前，成千上萬的紫斑蝶被疾駛的汽車撞死。從 2007 年起，國道單位開始採取保護措施。它在路旁架設了一道長約 1,100 公尺、高四公尺的網子，讓蝴蝶飛高一點，越過車流。在地的蝴蝶團體每天早上計算蝴蝶的數量，一分鐘內超過 250 隻飛越時，外側車道就會封閉。駕駛人不需要減速，只要遵守速限就好。觀賞蝴蝶的最佳時間是早上九點到十一點。
